name: Backstage
summary: A menu-bar command center for everything running in the background on your Mac: LaunchAgents, cron, your own scripts, with run history and one-click repairs.
story: Backstage lists every background job, explains what it does, spots crash loops and missing scripts, and runs your scripts with live output and history.

launcher.long: Lists launchd jobs, cron and your scripts; runs scripts with live output and history; diagnoses and repairs broken LaunchAgents.

installs.what: ~/Applications/Backstage.app (it also offers 'Update now' itself when the source is newer)
installs.note: if build.sh says the app is owned by root: sudo chown -R "$(whoami)":staff ~/Applications/Backstage.app

artifacts.what: Backstage-<version>.dmg + latest.json: the download link and the update feed every installed Backstage polls
